item: the shutdown stops the background jobs before the engine is disposed (A-029)
summary: The app's shutdown now asks every registered background job (backfills, enrichments, imports) to stop and waits for them all against one 5 s deadline before the log is written back and the database pool is disposed;before, a job still writing kept its connection open through the disposal and lost the unit it was writing at exit. A cancellable job stops at its next unit;one that cannot be interrupted is waited for but never flagged cancelled. Jobs still running after the deadline are named in the log by kind only (never their arguments). Stated limit: the count is not in the session-forensics record, whose dispose member has no byte room left (R201). Release-notes line: «Quitting the app now lets running background jobs (backfills, enrichments, imports) stop at a safe point, up to five seconds, before the database is closed.»
